<style>
/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */
:root{
  --navy:#0A2240; --navy-line:#23406A; --teal:#00897B; --teal-ink:#00695C; --teal-deep:#00574D; --teal-bg:#E6F4F2;
  --mint:#00CEA6; --mint-bg:#D9F5EE; --mist:#F4F6F8; --white:#FFFFFF; --line:#E1E7EE; --line-2:#D3DBE4;
  --body:#45566B; --muted:#5C6B7D; --on-navy:#B9C6D6; --rust:#9A3412; --rust-line:#C2410C; --pass:#0B6B3A; --wait:#9A5B00;
  --f-head:"Sora",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--mist);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal-ink)} a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-head);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* AI SEO services page additions */
.crumbs{padding-top:28px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-right:6px;color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.crumbs+.hero{padding-top:20px}
.eyebrow-teal{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.audit-card{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08)}
.audit-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy)}
.audit-tag{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.audit-grid{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.audit-grid li{padding:22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.audit-grid b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.audit-grid span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
@media (max-width:720px){.audit-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.audit-tag{margin-left:0}}
.note-line{color:var(--body);font-size:16px;max-width:38em;flex-basis:100%}
.head-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.head-stack .lede{font-size:17px}
.services .service-grid .service{flex:1 1 320px}
.service p+p{margin-top:-6px}
.service a{font-weight:600}
.how{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px}
.step{padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.step-n{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.step h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.step p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.compare{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.compare-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.compare-head .lede{max-width:38em}
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.cmp{width:100%;min-width:640px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px}

<script>
/* Table of contents: open on desktop, collapsed on mobile, highlight the current section */
(function () {
  var toc = document.querySelector('.toc');
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 981px)');
  function sync() { toc.open = mq.matches; }
  sync();
  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', sync);
  toc.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function () { if (!mq.matches) toc.open = false; });
  });
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  var links = {};
  toc.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (a) { links[a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)] = a; });
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (e) {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        Object.keys(links).forEach(function (k) { links[k].classList.toggle('is-active', k === e.target.id); });
      }
    });
  }, {rootMargin: '-90px 0px -70% 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('.post-body h2[id]').forEach(function (h) { io.observe(h); });
})();
</script>

/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */

.tag-saas{background:#FCEFD9;color:#7A4800}
.post-card{position:relative;padding:26px 26px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.post-card .tag{align-self:flex-start}
.post-card:hover{border-color:var(--line-2);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(10,34,64,.08)}
.post-card h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.post-card h3 a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.post-card h3 a::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:24px}
.post-card h3 a:hover{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.post-card .meta{margin-top:auto;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.byline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.byline img{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex:none}
.byline b{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.byline a{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.byline a:hover{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:underline}
.byline .sep{color:var(--line-2);margin:0 6px}
.post-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,300px),1fr));gap:20px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}

/* Single blog post */
.crumbs-left ol{justify-content:flex-start}
.post-hero{max-width:calc(1000px + 40px);padding-top:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px}
a.tag{text-decoration:none}
a.tag:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.post-hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.4vw,54px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:22ch}
.post-cover{max-width:calc(1000px + 40px);margin:36px auto 0}
.post-cover img{width:100%;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white)}
.post-layout{max-width:calc(1000px + 40px);padding-block:48px 72px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px minmax(0,1fr);gap:56px;align-items:start}
.post-side{position:sticky;top:96px}
.toc summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.toc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.toc ol{list-style:none;margin:14px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;border-left:2px solid var(--line)}
.toc a{display:block;padding:7px 0 7px 14px;margin-left:-2px;border-left:2px solid transparent;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--body);text-decoration:none}
.toc a:hover{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.toc a.is-active{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;border-left-color:var(--teal)}
@media (min-width:981px){.toc summary{pointer-events:none}.toc summary::after{display:none}}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .post-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;padding-top:32px}
  .post-side{position:static}
  .toc{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 18px}
  .toc summary{min-height:32px}
  .toc summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;font-size:20px;color:var(--teal-ink)}
  .toc[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
}
.post-body{max-width:38em;font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:#2F3F52}
.post-body>*+*{margin-top:1.1em}
.post-body h2{font-size:29px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--navy);margin-top:2em;scroll-margin-top:100px}
.post-body h2:first-of-type{margin-top:1.4em}
.post-body h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--navy);margin-top:1.6em;scroll-margin-top:100px}
.post-body h2+p,.post-body h3+p,.post-body h2+figure{margin-top:.7em}
.post-body a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:3px;font-weight:500}
.post-body a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep);text-decoration-thickness:2px}
.post-body ul,.post-body ol{padding-left:1.3em}
.post-body li+li{margin-top:.4em}
.post-body li::marker{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.post-body blockquote{margin:1.6em 0;padding:4px 0 4px 22px;border-left:4px solid var(--mint);font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:21px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--navy)}
.post-body strong{color:var(--navy)}
.post-fig{margin:1.6em 0}
.post-fig img{width:100%;max-width:540px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white)}
.post-body .table-wrap{margin:1.6em 0;border-radius:18px}
.post-table{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.55;min-width:620px}
.post-table th,.post-table td{padding:14px 16px}
.post-table thead th:last-child{background:#FAFBFC;color:var(--navy)}
.post-table td:last-child{color:var(--body);background:none}
.post-table tbody th{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);width:auto;white-space:nowrap}
.post-faq{margin-top:2.4em;padding:8px clamp(20px,3vw,32px) clamp(20px,3vw,28px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}
.post-faq h2{margin-top:.9em}
.qa{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:1em;margin-top:1.1em}
.qa h3{margin-top:0;font-size:19px}
.qa p{margin-top:.5em;font-size:17px}
.author-box{margin-top:3em;padding:28px;display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:flex-start}
.author-box img{width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:20px;object-fit:cover;flex:none}
.author-box>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.author-box .eyebrow{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.author-name{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:21px;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.2}
.author-box p{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.6}
.author-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 22px}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .post-body{font-size:17px}
  .post-body h2{font-size:25px}
  .author-box{flex-direction:column;padding:22px}
  .post-table{min-width:0}
  .post-table tbody th{white-space:normal;padding:16px 18px 6px}
  .post-cover img{border-radius:16px}
}
.related{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.related-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding-top:56px}
.related-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,36px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1}
.related-head a{font-weight:600}

/* Readability: line length in em */
main p{max-width:38em}

/* Additions for carried-over posts */
.post-body h4{font-size:18.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;color:var(--navy);margin-top:1.4em}
.post-body h3+h4,.post-body h4+p{margin-top:.6em}
.post-fig img{max-width:100%}
.post-fig.is-tall img{max-width:540px}
.post-fig figcaption{margin-top:.6em;text-align:center;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.post-body .callout{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--teal);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 22px}
.post-body .callout>*+*{margin-top:.6em}
.post-body .callout p{font-size:17px}
.post-table.plain td{color:var(--body);background:none}
.inline-related{list-style:none;padding:0!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.inline-related li{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px}
.inline-related li+li{margin-top:0}
.inline-related img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover;flex:none}
.inline-related p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.55}
.inline-related p+p{margin-top:.3em}
.qa>*+*{margin-top:.6em}
.qa ul,.qa ol{font-size:17px}
@media (max-width:600px){.inline-related img{width:56px;height:56px}.post-body .callout{padding:16px 18px}}
.post-body h4,.post-body h5,.post-body h6,article h4,article h5,article h6{font-family:var(--f-head)}</style>

<style>
/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */
:root{
  --navy:#0A2240; --navy-line:#23406A; --teal:#00897B; --teal-ink:#00695C; --teal-deep:#00574D; --teal-bg:#E6F4F2;
  --mint:#00CEA6; --mint-bg:#D9F5EE; --mist:#F4F6F8; --white:#FFFFFF; --line:#E1E7EE; --line-2:#D3DBE4;
  --body:#45566B; --muted:#5C6B7D; --on-navy:#B9C6D6; --rust:#9A3412; --rust-line:#C2410C; --pass:#0B6B3A; --wait:#9A5B00;
  --f-head:"Sora",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--mist);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal-ink)} a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-head);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}

<script>
/* Close desktop dropdowns when clicking elsewhere or opening another */
document.querySelectorAll('.menu details').forEach(function (d) {
  d.addEventListener('toggle', function () {
    if (d.open) document.querySelectorAll('.menu details').forEach(function (o) { if (o !== d) o.open = false; });
  });
});
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.menu details[open], .burger[open]').forEach(function (d) { if (!d.contains(e.target)) d.open = false; });
});

/* Table of contents: open on desktop, collapsed on mobile; close after a jump on mobile; highlight current question */
(function () {
  var toc = document.querySelector('.toc'); if (!toc) return;
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 981px)');
  function sync() { toc.open = mq.matches; }
  sync(); if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', sync);
  toc.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function () { if (!mq.matches) toc.open = false; });
  });
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  var links = {}; toc.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#q"]').forEach(function (a) { links[a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)] = a; });
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
    es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) {
      Object.keys(links).forEach(function (k) { links[k].classList.remove('is-on'); });
      var l = links[e.target.id]; if (l) l.classList.add('is-on');
    } });
  }, { rootMargin: '-110px 0px -65% 0px' });
  document.querySelectorAll('.qa h3[id^="q"]').forEach(function (h) { io.observe(h); });
})();
</script>

:root{
  --navy:#0A2240; --navy-line:#23406A; --teal:#00897B; --teal-ink:#00695C; --teal-deep:#00574D; --teal-bg:#E6F4F2;
  --mint:#00CEA6; --mint-bg:#D9F5EE; --mist:#F4F6F8; --white:#FFFFFF; --line:#E1E7EE; --line-2:#D3DBE4;
  --body:#45566B; --muted:#5C6B7D; --on-navy:#B9C6D6; --rust:#9A3412; --rust-line:#C2410C; --pass:#0B6B3A; --wait:#9A5B00;
  --f-head:"Sora",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--mist);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal-ink)} a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-head);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* AI SEO services page additions */
.crumbs{padding-top:28px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-right:6px;color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.crumbs+.hero{padding-top:20px}
.eyebrow-teal{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.audit-card{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08)}
.audit-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy)}
.audit-tag{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.audit-grid{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.audit-grid li{padding:22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.audit-grid b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.audit-grid span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
@media (max-width:720px){.audit-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.audit-tag{margin-left:0}}
.note-line{color:var(--body);font-size:16px;max-width:38em;flex-basis:100%}
.head-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.head-stack .lede{font-size:17px}
.services .service-grid .service{flex:1 1 320px}
.service p+p{margin-top:-6px}
.service a{font-weight:600}
.how{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px}
.step{padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.step-n{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.step h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.step p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.compare{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.compare-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.compare-head .lede{max-width:38em}
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.cmp{width:100%;min-width:640px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:16px 22px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmp tbody tr:last-child th,.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.cmp thead th{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;background:#FAFBFC}
.cmp thead th:last-child{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:600;width:22%}

<style>
/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */
:root{
  --navy:#0A2240; --navy-line:#23406A; --teal:#00897B; --teal-ink:#00695C; --teal-deep:#00574D; --teal-bg:#E6F4F2;
  --mint:#00CEA6; --mint-bg:#D9F5EE; --mist:#F4F6F8; --white:#FFFFFF; --line:#E1E7EE; --line-2:#D3DBE4;
  --body:#45566B; --muted:#5C6B7D; --on-navy:#B9C6D6; --rust:#9A3412; --rust-line:#C2410C; --pass:#0B6B3A; --wait:#9A5B00;
  --f-head:"Sora",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--mist);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal-ink)} a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-head);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

.pull{margin:8px 0;padding:30px 34px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--mint);border-radius:6px 24px 24px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;max-width:none}
.pull p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,24px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.38;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--navy)}
.pull footer{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.pull footer b{color:var(--navy)}
.ba{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,280px),1fr));gap:16px}
.ba .card{padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-radius:20px}
.ba h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ba ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;font-size:16px}
.ba li{position:relative;padding-left:28px;color:var(--body)}
.ba li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:7px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%}
.ba .before .lbl{color:var(--rust)}
.ba .before li::before{border:2px solid var(--rust-line)}
.ba .after{border-color:#BFE6DF;background:#F5FBFA}
.ba .after li{color:var(--navy)}
.ba .after li::before{background:var(--teal)}
.results-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,300px),1fr));gap:16px}
.result{padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;border-radius:20px}
.result b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:48px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.result h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:600}
.result p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.result.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.result.feature p{color:#E3F6F2}
.cs-sec>ol.phase-list,.phase-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-width:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,180px),1fr));gap:16px}
.phase-list li{padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;border-radius:20px}
.phase-when{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.phase-list h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.phase-list p{font-size:15.5px;color:var(--body)}
.related{padding-block:64px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.related .why-card .more{margin-top:auto}
.related .why-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,300px),1fr))}
.cs-faq{padding-top:32px}
.cs-cards.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,300px),1fr))}
.cs-big{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:34px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--teal)}
.cs-sec>ol.week-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.week-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.week-list li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.week-list .cs-num{width:48px;height:48px;font-size:15px}
.week-list h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin-bottom:8px}
.week-list p{color:var(--body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.7}
.cs-placeholder{padding:28px;border:2px dashed var(--rust-line);border-radius:20px;background:#FFF7F2;color:var(--rust);font-weight:600}
main p{max-width:38em}
@media (max-width:1060px){
  .cs-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding-top:56px}
  .cs-aside{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;position:static}
  .cs-article{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}
}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .hero .cs-sub{font-size:17px}
  .glance{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .glance li{padding:18px}
  .glance li:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1}
  .pull{padding:24px 22px}
  .cs-article{gap:56px}
}

.hero,.hub-hero,.hub-head{text-align:left}.hero>h1,.hero>p,.hero>span,.hero>.eyebrow,.hero>.founder-pill,.hub-hero>*,.hub-head>*{margin-left:0!important;margin-right:auto!important}.hero .hero-ctas{justify-content:flex-start!important;margin-left:0!important;margin-right:auto!important}.crumbs ol{justify-content:flex-start}</style>
